paragraphs: Mar bar Isak, and some say Chana bar Isak: [Ketubot 27b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.27b.11).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Ketubot gives Mari bar Isak or, alternatively, Chana bar Isak. Hyman has Mar rather than Mari in the first form.
[Heilprin’s name index](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=453&lang=en) lists two people named Mari bar Isak. It does not settle which reading to use in this passage.
